newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI APPOINTS NEW BOARD MEMBERS.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI APPOINTS NEW BOARD MEMBERS.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti has appointed new members to its board of directors, the company said in a statement received late on Monday.
"The Aamulehti group supervisory board appointed as new members of the board Pirkko Alitalo, Matti Jarventie and Tauno Matomaki," the company said. The new board members' term begins on January 1.
Yrjo Niskanen, whose term on the board was expiring, was reappointed to take the seat being vacated by retiring Olli Parola.
Continuing to serve on the Aamulehti board are Bengt Braun, Matti Hakkinen and Erkki Solja, the company said.
